ng-new.description: Creates a new Angular 22 workspace from the @floriandrevet/ng-template generator, with opt-in SSR, authentication, i18n, UI library, Docker and CI.

base.description: Applies the modernized application shell (used internally by ng-new; can be re-applied on an existing project).

ui.description: Adds a UI library (Angular Material, Tailwind CSS, or none) to the project.

auth.description: Adds authentication to the project (Microsoft Entra ID via MSAL, or generic OIDC).

i18n.description: Adds runtime internationalization (Transloco) to the project.

docker.description: Adds a multi-stage Dockerfile with runtime configuration injection.

ci.description: Adds a GitHub Actions CI workflow (lint, test, build) to the project.
